scope: Close the local DWG EED unsigned-size and following-field regression gap under 7K without adding a drawing fixture or promoting external support claims.

formatReference.observation: EED application records use a BS length that excludes the length prefix and application handle. R2007+ string items have their own 16-bit character length and UTF-16 data; the local encoder may split only between complete items.

method.kind: Generated AC1021 object-vector and full-file writer/reader controls
method.temporaryOutput: The generated full AC1021 DWG is written under the system temporary directory and removed by RAII cleanup.

assertions: The encoder accepts the exact boundary without treating it as a format maximum.
Raw envelope uses an unsigned BS length, the expected APPID handle, and a zero terminator.
All typed string values preserve exact order/content, and the following field sentinel is readable.
The unsigned BS length remains valid above signed 16-bit range.
Raw envelope and local reader agree on the chunk boundary and next-field cursor.
The maximum unsigned BS payload is represented exactly.
All 257 complete string items are retained in order and the following field sentinel remains aligned.
Chunking occurs only between complete items; the final 129-byte item is not split.
All item strings and APPID handles are recovered by the local EED reader.
A generated full AC1021 DWG reads both the EED-bearing LINE and the following LINE with correct coordinates; the latter has no XDATA.
A 32,767-character string whose encoded item cannot fit in one BS chunk is refused before emitting bytes.
Corrected data succeeds using the same writer buffer; local decode and following-field sentinel pass.

doesNotEstablish: independent producer or native CAD acceptance
same-APPID continuation semantics beyond the local writer/reader projection
a 32,767-byte per-APPID or drawing-wide EED format limit
resolution of ACadSharp or LibreDWG peer issue root causes
broader DWG/DXF feature completeness or support parity

planImpact.nextGate: Independent producer/native EED acceptance and same-APPID continuation semantics at the existing composed interoperability checkpoint; if unavailable, retain EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE_PENDING and continue the next local implementation-ready slice.
